reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 distinct exported speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages53-54-composition.json. Corrected malformed source readings 高さ(たか)さ to たかさ, 入り方(はいりかた) to はいりかた, and 絹(さや)さや to きぬさや. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical はし, はら, はずし, はで, はっすん, はんだん, はんぶん, はたらく, はっそう, はいち, はいりょ and lexical へんしゅう, へいめん, へんか, へや; conjunction または retained. Checked culinary readings ごしき, かいしき, ほじそ, むこうづけ, しゃっけい, しん・ぎょう・そう and てん・ち・じん against source. Loanwords converted to hiragana, long vowels and punctuation retained; terminal punctuation supplied. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
